steps: Join order_items, products, and category_translation to get English category names and item prices.
Filter for valid order statuses and aggregate by category to calculate total items sold and average item price (price).
Filter for categories with at least 50 items sold and order by average item price descending to find the highest.

args.purpose: Find category with highest average item price among categories with at least 50 items sold
args.sql:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
    COUNT(oi.order_id) AS items_sold,
    AVG(oi.price) AS avg_item_price
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(oi.order_id) >= 50
ORDER BY avg_item_price DESC
LIMIT 5;
